clues.ahaFactoid: Vertical heat pipes filled with ammonia keep the permafrost frozen beneath the stilts so warm oil never melts the Arctic tundra.

clues.ahaFactoid: Vishnu’s ten primary Dashavatara avatars—from fish Matsya to future Kalki—stand well beneath the auspicious 108 beads of a prayer mala.

clues.stem: Finish Henry Kissinger’s October 26, 1972 White House briefing line twelve days before Nixon’s landslide: "We believe that [ _____ ] is at hand."
clues.ahaFactoid: The premature optimism boosted Nixon’s reelection, though final Paris Peace Accords didn’t actually close until late January 1973.

clues.stem: Before or After? Which Cold War surprise came FIRST—the U.S. table-tennis team visiting Beijing or the Helsinki Accords?
clues.ahaFactoid: American paddler Glenn Cowan’s accidental bus ride sparked Ping-Pong Diplomacy in April 1971—four years before 1975’s Helsinki Accords.
